title: Run final TUI-oriented AgentOS audit
purpose: Decide whether AgentOS can claim TUI-oriented Alpha status and identify blockers for the next Production Distro wave.
scope: Parse all TUI task JSON and evidence files.
Run workspace tests and TUI-specific test suites.
Run functional, ecosystem, production runbook, TUI replay, release and QEMU gates.
Audit ownership boundaries for AgentCore, SecurityExecution, ecosystem resolver and agentd.
Write final audit decision and next-wave recommendations.
acceptance_criteria: Final audit includes pass/fail evidence for every TUI wave.
Boundary audit confirms TUI is projection-controller only.
Promotion decision is one of tui-oriented-alpha, remediation-required or rollout-blocked.
Next Production Distro tasks are listed with blockers if any.
failure_modes: Audit only checks documentation and not executable gates.
Promotion claim ignores TUI replay or QEMU evidence.
Audit accepts TUI-owned side effects or resolver logic.
